title: On-call schedule coverage — non-empty roster per shift window
summary: Share of shift windows in the rolling window whose roster resolution emitted a non-empty primary slot prior to the window opening. The on-call-rotation playbook's load-rotation-roster step writes one resolution per evaluated shift window; this KPI is the ratio of resolutions whose __current_on_call__ is non-empty over total resolutions in window. A coverage gap on a shift window is the operational condition that puts NIS2 Article 21(2)(b) and DORA Article 6 responder-readiness obligations at risk — there is no responder bound for the paging system to page, so no notification-window clock can be honoured.

target.rationale: Every shift window must have a bound primary responder before it opens; a gap is not partial credit.

measurement.formula: count(roster resolutions with non-empty __current_on_call__) / count(roster resolutions) over rolling window.

inputs.name: roster_evidence
inputs.description: roster-governance control attestation pinning the responder bound per shift window
